name: JK Omuchu ♥
source: Protagonist's daughter, Kanna, is highly praised for her excellent grades, athleticism, beauty and friendliness, but in reality she is a sloppy and disrespectful brat who constantly insults her own father and can't even clean up after herself. Protagonist plans to marry a young and kind busty teacher named Mei, who he hopes will help him improve his parenting skills and teach Kanna some manners. However, he soon discovers that his daughter has a bizarre fetish for wearing diapers and pleasuring herself, which he fears will ruin his chances with Mei. He decides to discipline Kanna harshly before their wedding.
translation: 主人公的女儿神无，因其优异的成绩、运动能力、美丽和友善而受到高度赞扬，但实际上她是一个邋遢、不尊重自己的孩子，经常侮辱自己的父亲，甚至连自己都不会收拾干净。主角计划与年轻善良的巨乳老师梅结婚，希望梅老师能帮助他提高育儿技巧，并教神无一些礼仪。然而，他很快发现女儿有一种奇怪的癖好，喜欢穿尿布和取悦自己，他担心这会毁掉他和梅的机会。他决定在婚礼前严厉惩罚卡娜。
